jobs.title: Global Reliability Engineering Lead

titleByLocale.it: Piombo di ingegneria della responsabilità globale
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable du génie de la fiabilité mondiale

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

• The Global Reliability Engineering Lead provides enterprise leadership for asset reliability, maintenance excellence, and engineering rigor across all CSL Behring manufacturing sites.

• This role drives global standardization of reliability methodologies, ensures consistency in maintenance work processes, and strengthens long-term asset performance.

• The position serves as a strategic partner to site reliability teams and centers of excellence by setting global expectations, supporting technical capability development, and promoting practices that improve equipment performance, reduce risk, and safeguard business continuity.

• All responsibilities must be executed in alignment with CSL’s patient-focused mission and Core Values, and with a high level of integrity, collaboration, and cultural awareness.

The Role:

• Global Reliability Framework and Direction -

• Establish and maintain the global reliability strategy that supports asset lifecycle performance, operational continuity, and alignment with CSL engineering standards.

• Develop standardized reliability frameworks, tools, and metrics that strengthen work process discipline across all manufacturing sites.

• Conduct global assessments to identify gaps, benchmark best practices, and ensure consistent application of reliability fundamentals.

• Monitor global KPIs related to asset reliability, maintenance efficiency, and operational risk, and communicate insights to site and regional leadership.

• Ensure adherence to regulatory expectations and internal quality requirements across all reliability-related activities.

• Technical Leadership and Engineering Excellence-

• Provide expert technical guidance for complex equipment challenges and high-risk investigations across the global network.

• Facilitate and mentor site teams in methods such as RCM, FMEA, RCA, predictive diagnostics, and other reliability engineering principles.

• Support the evaluation of new technologies, materials, and design approaches to ensure maintainability, reliability, and cost effectiveness.

• Review equipment installation, commissioning, and qualification plans to ensure alignment with asset lifecycle requirements.

• Drive improvement in preventive and predictive maintenance programs, including the use of advanced diagnostic tools.

• Global Collaboration and Capability Building-

• Partner with site engineering, maintenance, operations, quality, EHS, and OpEx teams to build shared understanding of reliability objectives and to strengthen network alignment.

• Lead global workshops, training programs, and knowledge sharing forums that build technical capability in reliability engineering.

• Support the development of global learning materials for maintenance engineering functions and ensure consistent training across sites.

• Promote open communication, cross-functional engagement, and collaborative problem-solving across regional and global teams.

• Demonstrate flexibility in work hours to support global stakeholders in different time zones.

• People and Culture Expectations -

• Reinforce CSL’s Core Values of Patient Focus, Innovation, Integrity, Collaboration, and Superior Performance in all interactions.

• Serve as a cultural ambassador who models professionalism, ethical behavior, sound judgment, and inclusive collaboration.

• Support global safety expectations by consistently using required PPE when on site and complying with occupational health and safety practices.

• Other Responsibilities-

• Foster a respectful and positive environment where continuous improvement, accountability, and learning are encouraged.

• Provide technical input during capital project reviews related to maintainability, reliability risk, and long term asset performance.

• Participate in audits, inspections, and program reviews to ensure compliance and drive continuous improvement.

• Contribute to strategic initiatives and business priorities led by global engineering or Ka

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'opportunità: - Il Global Reliability Engineering Lead fornisce la leadership aziendale per l'affidabilità, l'eccellenza della manutenzione e il rigore ingegneristico in tutti i siti di produzione CSL Behring. - Questo ruolo guida la standardizzazione globale delle metodologie di affidabilità, assicura la coerenza nei processi di manutenzione e rafforza le prestazioni di asset a lungo termine. - La posizione funge da partner strategico per team di affidabilità del sito e centri di eccellenza impostando aspettative globali, supportando lo sviluppo delle capacità tecniche e promuovendo pratiche che migliorano le prestazioni delle attrezzature, riducono il rischio e salvaguardano la continuità aziendale. - Tutte le responsabilità devono essere eseguite in allineamento con la missione focalizzata sul paziente e i valori fondamentali della CSL, e con un alto livello di integrità, collaborazione e consapevolezza culturale. Il ruolo: - Global Reliability Framework and Direction - - Stabilire e mantenere la strategia di affidabilità globale che supporta le prestazioni del ciclo di vita degli asset, la continuità operativa e l'allineamento con gli standard di ingegneria CSL. - Sviluppare framework, strumenti e metriche di affidabilità standardizzati che rafforzano la disciplina del processo di lavoro in tutti i siti di produzione. - Condurre valutazioni globali per identificare lacune, best practice di benchmark e garantire l'applicazione coerente dei fondamentali di affidabilità. - Monitorare i KPI globali relativi all'affidabilità degli asset, all'efficienza di manutenzione e al rischio operativo, e comunicare intuizioni alla leadership del sito e regionale. - Assicurare l'adesione alle aspettative normative e ai requisiti di qualità interna in tutte le attività correlate all'affidabilità. - Leadership tecnica e ingegneria eccellenza- - Fornire una guida tecnica esperta per complesse sfide e indagini ad alto rischio in tutta la rete globale. - Facilitate e tutor team di siti in metodi come RCM, FMEA, RCA, diagnostica predittiva e altri principi di ingegneria di affidabilità. - Supporta la valutazione di nuove tecnologie, materiali e approcci di progettazione per garantire la manutenbilità, l'affidabilità e l'efficacia dei costi. - Verificare l'installazione, la messa in servizio e i piani di qualificazione per garantire l'allineamento con i requisiti del ciclo di vita degli asset. - Miglioramento dell'azionamento nei programmi di manutenzione preventiva e predittiva, compreso l'uso di strumenti diagnostici avanzati. - Global Collaboration and Capability Building- - Partner con i team di progettazione, manutenzione, operazioni, qualità, EHS e OpEx per la comprensione condivisa degli obiettivi di affidabilità e per rafforzare l'allineamento della rete. - Condurre workshop globali, programmi di formazione e forum di condivisione delle conoscenze che costruiscono capacità tecniche nell'ingegneria dell'affidabilità. - Sostenere lo sviluppo di materiali di apprendimento globali per le funzioni di ingegneria della manutenzione e garantire una formazione coerente tra i siti. - Promuovere la comunicazione aperta, l'impegno interfunzionale e la risoluzione dei problemi collaborativi tra team regionali e globali. - Dimostrare flessibilità nelle ore di lavoro per sostenere gli stakeholder globali in diverse fusi orari. - Persone e culture - - Rinforzare i valori fondamentali della CSL del focus paziente, innovazione, integrità, collaborazione e prestazioni superiori in tutte le interazioni. - Servire come ambasciatore culturale che modella professionalità, comportamento etico, giudizio sonoro e collaborazione inclusiva. - Sostenere le aspettative di sicurezza globali utilizzando costantemente PPE richiesto quando sul posto e rispettare le pratiche di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro. - Altre responsabilità - Promuovere un ambiente rispettoso e positivo in cui vengono incoraggiati continui miglioramenti, responsabilità e apprendimento. - Fornire input tecnici durante le recensioni dei progetti di capitale relativi a manutenbilità, rischio di affidabilità e prestazioni di asset a lungo termine. - Partecipare a audit, ispezioni e recensioni di programmi per garantire la conformità e guidare il miglioramento continuo. - Contribuire a iniziative strategiche e priorità di business guidate dall'ingegneria globale o da Ka

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione La possibilité : - Le Global Reliability Engineering Lead assure la direction de l'entreprise pour la fiabilité des actifs, l'excellence de maintenance et la rigueur technique sur tous les sites de fabrication CSL Behring. - Ce rôle stimule la normalisation mondiale des méthodes de fiabilité, assure la cohérence des processus de maintenance et renforce la performance des actifs à long terme. - Le poste sert de partenaire stratégique aux équipes de fiabilité du site et aux centres d'excellence en établissant des attentes mondiales, en appuyant le développement des capacités techniques et en favorisant des pratiques qui améliorent la performance des équipements, réduisent les risques et garantissent la continuité des activités. - Toutes les responsabilités doivent être exécutées en accord avec la mission axée sur le patient et les valeurs fondamentales du CSL, et avec un haut niveau d'intégrité, de collaboration et de sensibilisation culturelle. Le rôle : - Cadre et orientation de fiabilité mondiale - - Établir et maintenir la stratégie de fiabilité globale qui appuie la performance du cycle de vie des actifs, la continuité opérationnelle et l'alignement sur les normes d'ingénierie CSL. - Élaborer des cadres de fiabilité, des outils et des mesures normalisés qui renforcent la discipline des processus de travail dans tous les sites de fabrication. - Effectuer des évaluations globales afin d'identifier les lacunes, de comparer les meilleures pratiques et d'assurer une application cohérente des principes de fiabilité. - Surveiller les ICR mondiaux liés à la fiabilité des actifs, à l'efficacité de la maintenance et aux risques opérationnels, et communiquer des renseignements au leadership local et régional. - Assurer le respect des attentes réglementaires et des exigences internes en matière de qualité pour toutes les activités liées à la fiabilité. - Leadership technique et excellence en génie - Fournir des conseils techniques spécialisés pour les problèmes complexes d'équipement et les enquêtes à haut risque dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial. - Faciliter et encadrer les équipes de site dans des méthodes telles que RCM, FMEA, RCA, diagnostics prédictifs et autres principes d'ingénierie de la fiabilité. - Appuyer l'évaluation des nouvelles technologies, des nouveaux matériaux et des approches de conception pour assurer la maintenance, la fiabilité et la rentabilité. - Examiner les plans d'installation, de mise en service et de qualification de l'équipement afin d'assurer l'alignement sur les exigences du cycle de vie des biens. - Favoriser l'amélioration des programmes de maintenance préventive et prédictive, y compris l'utilisation d'outils de diagnostic avancés. - Collaboration mondiale et renforcement des capacités - S'associer à des équipes d'ingénierie, de maintenance, d'exploitation, de qualité, d'EHS et d'OpEx pour développer une compréhension commune des objectifs de fiabilité et renforcer l'alignement du réseau. - Diriger des ateliers mondiaux, des programmes de formation et des forums de partage des connaissances qui renforcent les capacités techniques en ingénierie de la fiabilité. - Appuyer la mise au point de matériel d'apprentissage mondial pour les fonctions d'ingénierie de la maintenance et assurer une formation cohérente entre les sites. - Promouvoir la communication ouverte, l'engagement interfonctionnel et la résolution de problèmes en collaboration entre les équipes régionales et mondiales. - Faire preuve de souplesse dans les heures de travail pour aider les acteurs mondiaux dans différents fuseaux horaires. - Servir d'ambassadeur culturel qui modélise le professionnalisme, le comportement éthique, le jugement sain et la collaboration inclusive. - Soutenir les attentes mondiales en matière de sécurité en utilisant systématiquement les EPI requis sur place et en respectant les pratiques de santé et de sécurité au travail. - Autres responsabilités - Favoriser un environnement respectueux et positif où l'on encourage l'amélioration continue, la responsabilisation et l'apprentissage. - Fournir des données techniques lors de l'examen des projets d'immobilisations concernant la maintenance, le risque de fiabilité et le rendement à long terme des actifs. - jobs.description:
This role is a position in the Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department within CSL Technical Operations. The ideal candidate has a solid track record in the development of drug delivery devices, from concept development through commercialization and product maintenance. This role requires experience in leading user interface development and a passion for making the right product that meets the needs of the patients.
The ideal candidate will understand how CSL drug delivery devices operate and the interface to users and will translate this into design of the user interface and instructional materials.
CSL is looking to transform our Human Factors Engineering team from mainly executing formative and summative studies to more front-end development work. This includes evaluation and selection of commercially available device and primary packaging components, as well as user interface development to meet user needs.

Responsibilities

• Act as Lead Human Factors Engineer

• Plan and execute Human Factors Engineering activities in drug delivery device projects, including development of secondary packaging and Instructions for Use

• Set and drive best practices within DDS&P for Human Factors Engineering

• Support standardization of approaches for Task Analysis, Use Risk Assessment, and other key deliverables

• Lead HF oversight of secondary packaging development

• Partner with project leads and the cross-functional development team on planning and execution of projects

• Lead development of selection criteria and evaluation of the user interface for new products

• Collect, maintain, and utilize data on user capabilities and known use problems with combination products

• Contribute to the development of Company Core Data Sheets (CCDS)

• Plan and execute Formative and Summative evaluations, including selection and oversight of CROs

• Leverage existing data to support regulatory submissions, e.g., comparative analysis

• Develop dossier submissions for HF content, including HFE/UE Report, and responses to regulatory agency questions

• Monitor industry trends, standards, and regulatory guidance

Qualifications

• Excellent communication skills and a track record working in a matrix environment

• Ability to influence and promote a culture of continuous improvement

• Subject Matter Expertise on:

• IEC 62366 family of standards and related regulatory guidance

• User Capabilities – anthropometric basis

• Use Risk Assessments

• Proven track record of:

• Evaluation of user interfaces for drug delivery devices

• Development of instructional materials for product labelling and artwork

• Relevant academic qualification in an appropriate field, e.g., Ergonomics, Psychology or a suitable Science or Engineering degree

• At least 8 years of related experience in the pharmaceutical or medical device industry

• Ability to travel internationally up to 20%

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia di proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e continuare a rafinare le modalità in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a vite complete. jobs.description:
Role Overview:
The Senior Director of Market Access for Inline Assets will be responsible for shaping and implementing market access strategies for CSL Behring inline assets. This role is accountable for maximizing the asset total life cycle value throughout product life cycle. It requires strong expertise in obtaining, sustaining, and optimizing product pricing & reimbursement, and a comprehensive understanding of the payer environment in key international markets.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the Market Access inline team in one Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global market access inline team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and accountability.
• Serve as a key member of the global Market Access Leadership Team (MALT), contributing to the development and execution of functional strategy, operations, and capability building.
• Accountable for Market Access deliverables during the inline phase, continuously refining and improving standards for these deliverables.
• Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Marketing, and other partner functions to influence brand strategy and execution, ensuring proper integration of market access considerations.
• Keep abreast with payer policies and regulations, economic data within the assigned TA in key international markets. Identify market access opportunities and risks, capture opportunities, mitigate risks through proactive planning, scenario analysis, and stakeholder engagement.
• Deliver and periodically update the Global Value Dossier as a foundational document for affiliate Pricing & Reimbursement (P&R) and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions and resubmissions.
• Provide guidance and support to country teams in P&R and HTA submissions, negotiations, and authority responses, ensuring alignment with global strategies.
• Optimize payer value propositions (PVPs) and health economic models to effectively communicate the clinical and economic value of inline assets to payers and other key stakeholders.
• Continuously drive the development of lifecycle payer evidence and optimize pricing strategies to maintain and enhance P&R throughout the product lifecycle.
• Provide systematic market access insights for forecasting and long-range planning, including analysis of key payer policy changes, risk assessments, and opportunity identification.
• Represent CSL at global trade associations, participating in access-related committees and working groups to influence industry standards and practices.

Qualifications:
• At least 12 years of experience in market access, with significant exposure to diverse healthcare systems in the international markets.
• Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams in a global, crossfunctional environment. A role model of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and accountability.
• Proven track record in obtaining, sustaining, and optimizing pricing, reimbursement, and patient access across diverse healthcare systems in international markets.
• Extensive knowledge of global healthcare systems, payer landscapes, and the interplay between market access and international markets.
• Proven ability to deliver superior performance across diverse healthcare systems in the international markets.
• An advanced degree in Health Economics, Public Health, or a related field is required.

About CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ruolo Ruolo Panoramica: La Senior Director di Market Access per Inline Assets sarà responsabile della formazione e dell'implementazione di strategie di accesso al mercato per gli asset inline di CSL Behring. Questo ruolo è responsabile del massimo valore del ciclo di vita dell'asset durante l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto. Richiede una forte competenza nell'ottenimento, nella sostenibilità e nell'accettazione del prezzo e della rimborsabilità del prodotto, nonché una comprensione completa dell'ambiente dei pagari nei principali mercati internazionali. Mansioni - Guidare l'equipe di Market Access inline in un'Area Terapeutica (TA). Costruire, guidare e guidare un'equipe globale di market access inline di alto rendimento, promuovendo una cultura di collaborazione, innovazione, inclusione e responsabilità. - Partecipare come membro chiave del Team di Leadership Globale di Market Access (MALT), contribuendo allo sviluppo e all'esecuzione della strategia funzionale, delle operazioni e della costruzione delle capacità. - Responsabile dei risultati di Market Access durante la fase inline, continuando a perfezionare e migliorare gli standard per risultati. - Collaborare con Medical Affairs, Marketing e altre funzioni partner per influenzare la strategia e l'esecuzione del marchio, assicurando un'integrazione corretta delle considerazioni di accesso al mercato. - Mantenersi aggiornati sulle politiche dei pagari e le normative, sui dati economici all'interno dell'assegnata TA nei principali mercati internazionali. Identificare le opportunità e i rischi di accesso al mercato, catturare le opportunità, mitigare i rischi attraverso la pianificazione proattiva, l'analisi dei scenari e l'interazione con i stakeholder. - E prospettive e prospettive aggiornate il Dossier di Valore Globale come documento fondamentale per le sottoscrizioni e le riassegnazioni di prezzo e rimborsabilità (P&R) e le teorie tecnologiche della salute (HTA) presso le filiali. - Fornire orientamento e supporto alle squadre dei paesi nelle sottoscrizioni e nelle riassegnazioni di P&R e HTA, assicurando l'allineamento con le strategie globali. - Ottimizzare le proposte di valore dei pagari (PVPs) e i modelli economici della salute per comunicare il valore clinico ed economico degli asset inline ai pagari e agli altri stakeholder chiave. - Continuare a guidare lo sviluppo di prove di accesso al mercato a ciclo di vita e ottimizzare le strategie di prezzo per mantenere e migliorare la P&R durante l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Fornire informazioni sistematiche di accesso al mercato per la previsione e la pianificazione a lungo termine, inclusa l'analisi delle principali modifiche delle politiche dei pagari, le conseguenze dei rischi e l'assunzione delle opportunità. - Rappresentare CSL presso le associazioni commerciali globali, partecipando a comitati e gruppi di lavoro relativi all'accesso per influenzare gli standard e le pratiche dell'industria.
• Requisiti - Almeno 12 anni di esperienza in mercato, con una significativa esposizione ai sistemi sanitari diversi nei mercati internazionali. - Prova di guida e sviluppata squadre di alto rendimento in un ambiente globale e interfunzionale. Un modello di collaborazione, innovazione, inclusione e responsabilità. - Prova di aver ottenuto, sostenuto e ottimizzato il prezzo, la rimborsabilità e l'accesso dei pazienti in sanitari diversi nei mercati internazionali. - Conoscenza estesa dei sistemi sanitari globali, dei paesaggi dei pagari e dell'accettazione tra l'accesso al mercato e i mercati internazionali. - Prova di essere in grado di ottenere un superiore rendimento in sistemi sanitari diversi nei mercati internazionali. - Un titolo di studio avanzato in Economia della Salute, Salute Pubblica o una disciplina correlata è richiesto. Cosa? CSL Vifor è un partner globale di scelta per le farmaceutiche e le terapie innovative in carenza di ferro e nefrologia. Specializzare nella partnership strategica globale, nella licenza e nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella commercializzazione dei prodotti farmaceutici per la precisione della cura, mirando a aiutare i pazienti in tutto il mondo a uccidere vite migliori e più sane. Con sede a St. Gallen, Svizzera, CSL Vifor comprende anche la società congiunta Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (con Fresenius Medical Care). La società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone.

Costruire, guidare e guidare un'equipe globale di market access inline di alto rendimento, promuovendo una cultura di collazione, innovazione, inclusione e responsabilità. - Partecipare come membro chiave del Team di Leadership Globale di Market Access (MALT), contribuendo allo sviluppo e all'esecuzione della strategia funzionale, delle opérazioni e della costruzione delle capacità. - Responsabile dei risultati di Market Access dure la fase inline, continue a perfezionare e migliorare gli standard per questi risultati. - Collaborare con Medical Affairs, Marketing e altre funzioni partenaire per influenzare la strategia e l'escuzione del marchio, assicurando un'integrazione corretta delle considerazioni di accesso al mercato. - Mantenersi aggiornato sulle politicihe dei pagatori e le normative, sui dati economici all'interno dell'assegnata TA nei maini mercati internazioni. Identificare le opportunà e i rischi di accesso al mercato, catturare le opportunà, mitigare i rischi attraverso la pianificazione proattiva, l'analisi dei scenari e l'interazione con i parties prenantes. - Eseguire e periodimente aggiornare il Dossier di Valore Globale come documento fondamentale per le sottoscrizioni e le riassegnazioni di prezzo e rimborsabilità (P&R) e le valutazioni tecnologiche della saluable (HTA) presso le filiali. - Fornire orientalo e supporto alle square dei paesi nelle sottoscrizioni e nelle riassegnazioni di P&R e HTA, assicurando l'allineamento con le strategie globali. - Ottimizzare le proposte di valore dei pagatori (PVP) e i modelli economici della salu per comunicare efficacemente il valore clinico ed economico degli asset inline ai pagatori e agli altri parties prenantes chiave. - Continuer a guidare lo sviluppo di provide di accesso al mercato a ciclo di vita e ottimizzare le strategie di prezzo per mantenere e migliorare la P&R durant l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Fornire informazioni sistematiche di accesso al mercato per la previsione e la pianificazione a lungo termine, inclusa l'analisi delle principali modifiche delle politicalhe dei pagatori, le valutazioni dei rischi e l'identification delle opportunità. - Rappresentare CSL presso le associazioni commerciali globali, participando a comitati e gruppi di lavoro relativi all'accesso per influenzare gli standard e le pratiche dell'industrie.
• Requisiti - Almeno 12 anni di esperienza in accesso al mercato, con una significativa esposzione ai sistemi sanitari diversi nei mercati internazioni. - Prova di aver guidato e sviluppato square di alto rendimento in un ambiente global e interfunzionale. Un modello di collabazione, innovazione, inclusione e responsabilità. - Prova di aver ottenuto, sostenuto e ottimizzato il prezzo, la rimborsabilità e l'accesso dei pazienti in sistemi sanitari diversi nei mercati internazionali. - Conoscenza estesa dei sistemi sanitari globali, dei paesaggi dei pagatori e dell'interazione tra l'accesso al mercato e i mercati internazioni. - Prova di essere in grado di ottenere un superiore rendimento in sistemi sanitari diversi nei mercati internazionali. - Un titolo di studio avanzato à Economia della Salute, Salute Pubblica o una disciplina correlata è ritiesto.
• Cosa offriamo CSL Vifor è un partenaire globale di scelta per le farcaceutiche e le terapie innovative in carenza di ferro e nefrologia. Spécializziamo nella partnership strategica globale, nella licenza e nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nella commercializzazione dei prodotti farmaceutici per la precisione della cura, mirando a aiutare i pazienti in tutto il mondo a condurre vite migliori e più sane. Con sede a St. Gallen, Svizzera, CSL Vifor comprende anne la società congiunta Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (con Fresenius Medical Care). La société madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australie, impiega 32.000 persone.

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur, Talent Partner, Opérations

jobs.description:
Position Overview
The Director, Talent Partner is a pivotal strategic HR leadership role responsible for shaping and delivering enterprise-aligned talent strategies within the Operations, Plasma, Commercial, Enabling Functions & R&D or Seqirus. Serving as the principal talent advisor to senior leadership, this role ensures that workforce, leadership, and culture priorities directly enable business performance, transformation, and long-term growth.
Each Talent Partner reports directly to the Vice President/Executive Director, Human Resources for their designated business area and collaborates closely with the Talent COEs and broader HR community to drive an integrated approach to Talent Management.

Reporting Relationships:
This position reports to the most senior HRBP Lead for the BU or function.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
1. Business/Function Strategic Talent Partnership
· As part of the enterprise talent strategy - serve as the senior-most talent advisor to business or function leaders, translating local business strategy, performance drivers, and future capability needs into actionable talent plans for their areas.
· Shape and influence organizational design, leadership composition, and workforce strategy to enable growth, innovation, and operational excellence for the business or function.

2. Talent Management & Succession Planning
· Leveraging CoE, lead the strategy, execution, and governance of talent management processes across the business area, ensuring depth, diversity, and readiness of internal talent pipelines.
· Drive succession planning. Partnering with CoE and VP/ED HR, facilitate rigorous talent reviews and development planning and internal mobility.
· Partner with the CoE to accelerate high-potential talent and strengthen leadership capability globally.
· Leverage talent dashboards and analytics to understand health of the pipeline and develop action plans

3. Workforce Planning, Capability & Skill Building
· In partnership with VP/ED and CoE conduct ongoing workforce skills assessment and planning and future talent requirements, risks, and gaps.
· Develop and implement capability-building strategies—including build/buy/borrow/bot/bounce talent approaches—to ensure the business remains future-ready.

4. Employee Experience & Engagement
· In partnership with the enterprise CoE, champion local business or function initiatives that elevate engagement, culture, and wellbeing, ensuring a cohesive and compelling employee experience across geographies.
· Provide insight-driven recommendations across listening events to enhance retention, inclusion, and team effectiveness.

5. Collaboration & Enterprise Integration
· Work closely with other Talent Partners in the business and CoE to align processes, share insights, and drive consistency in how talent is identified, developed, and supported globally.
· Partner cross-functionally across HR to ensure an integrated talent approach that enables both enterprise and local business objectives.

6. Data-Driven Talent Insights
· Leverage talent analytics to inform strategy, measure progress, and highlight organisational risks or opportunities for the BU or Function.
· Translate workforce, succession, and talent pipeline data into clear insights that inform business and HR decision-making for the BU or Function
· Conduct trend analysis on movement, performance, potential, retention risks, and diversity to identify opportunities or emerging risks for the BU or Function
· Leverage dashboards for real-time visibility into talent health and organizational capability for the BU or Function
· Maintain awareness of external market conditions for talent – partnering with CoE

7. Leadership Cohorts
· Where appropriate- partner with CoE for the implementation of leadership cohort development within the business area, ensuring alignment with enterprise leadership models.

​
Required Qualifications & Experience

• Significant experience in HR business partnering or talent

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione Panoramica Il Direttore, Talent Partner è un ruolo chiave di leadership strategica delle risorse umane responsabile della formazione e della fornitura di strategie di talento all'interno delle Operazioni, Plasma, Commerciale, Attivazione Funzioni & R&D o Seqirus. Servendo come consulente di talento principale per la leadership senior, questo ruolo assicura che la forza lavoro, la leadership e le priorità culturali consentono direttamente le prestazioni aziendali, la trasformazione e la crescita a lungo termine. Ogni Talent Partner riferisce direttamente al Vice President/Executive Director, Human Resources per la loro area di business designata e collabora strettamente con i Talent COEs e la comunità HR più ampia per guidare un approccio integrato alla Talent Management. Rapporti: Questa posizione riporta al più anziano HRBP Lead per la BU o la funzione. Responsabilità e responsabilità principali: 1. Partenariato Strategico di Talent Business/Function · Come parte della strategia di talento aziendale - servire come consulente di talento più anziano per i leader di affari o funzioni, traducendo la strategia aziendale locale, i driver di performance e le capacità future ha bisogno di piani di talento attuabili per le loro aree. · Forma e influenza la progettazione organizzativa, la composizione della leadership e la strategia della forza lavoro per consentire la crescita, l'innovazione e l'eccellenza operativa per il business o la funzione. 2. Gestione del talento e pianificazione della successione · Leveraging CoE, guidare la strategia, l'esecuzione e la governance dei processi di gestione dei talenti in tutta l'area aziendale, garantendo profondità, diversità e disponibilità di pipeline di talenti interni. · Progettare la successione. Collaborare con CoE e VP/ED HR, facilitare rigorose recensioni di talenti e pianificazione dello sviluppo e mobilità interna. · Partner con il CoE per accelerare il talento altamente potenziale e rafforzare la capacità di leadership a livello globale. · Leva cruscotti di talento e analisi per capire la salute della pipeline e sviluppare piani di azione 3. Pianificazione delle forze di lavoro, Capability & Skill Building · In collaborazione con VP/ED e CoE condurre la valutazione continua delle competenze della forza lavoro e la pianificazione e futuri requisiti di talento, rischi e lacune. · Sviluppare e implementare strategie di creazione di capacità, tra cui approcci di creazione/buy/borrow/bot/bounce, per garantire che il business rimanga pronto per il futuro. 4. Esperienza e coinvolgimento dei dipendenti · In collaborazione con l'impresa CoE, campione di iniziative locali di business o di funzione che elevano impegno, cultura e benessere, garantendo un'esperienza dipendente coesa e avvincente in tutte le geografie. · Fornire consigli guidati attraverso gli eventi di ascolto per migliorare la ritenzione, l'inclusione e l'efficacia del team. 5. Collaborazione e integrazione delle imprese · Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri partner Talent nel business e CoE per allineare processi, condividere intuizioni e guidare la coerenza in come il talento è identificato, sviluppato e supportato a livello globale. · Partner cross-functionally attraverso le risorse umane per garantire un approccio integrato di talento che consenta sia gli obiettivi aziendali che locali. 6. Data-Driven Talent · Levare l'analisi dei talenti per informare la strategia, misurare i progressi e evidenziare i rischi organizzativi o le opportunità per la BU o la funzione. · Tradurre i dati della forza lavoro, della successione e del talento in chiare intuizioni che informano il processo decisionale aziendale e HR per la BU o la funzione · Condurre l'analisi della tendenza sul movimento, le prestazioni, il potenziale, i rischi di ritenzione e la diversità per identificare opportunità o rischi emergenti per la BU o la funzione · dashboard di levaggio per visibilità in tempo reale nella salute del talento e capacità organizzativa per la BU o la funzione · Mantenere la consapevolezza delle condizioni di mercato esterne per il talento – collaborando con CoE 7. Coorte di Leadership · Ove appropriato- partner con CoE per l'attuazione della leadership coorte sviluppo all'interno dell'area di business, garantendo l'allineamento con i modelli di leadership aziendale. Qualificazioni e esperienze richieste
• Esperienza significativa nel business partner HR o talento

descriptionByLocale.de:
Lageübersicht Der Direktor, Talent Partner, ist eine zentrale strategische HR-Führungsrolle, die für die Gestaltung und Bereitstellung unternehmensorientierter Talentstrategien in den Bereichen Operations, Plasma, Commercial, Enabling Functions & R&D oder Seqirus verantwortlich ist. Als wichtigster Talentberater für Führungskräfte stellt diese Rolle sicher, dass Mitarbeiter-, Führungs- und Kulturprioritäten direkt Geschäftsleistung, Transformation und langfristiges Wachstum ermöglichen. Jeder Talent Partner berichtet direkt an den Vice President/Executive Director, Human Resources für seinen designierten Geschäftsbereich und arbeitet eng mit den Talent COEs und der breiteren HR-Community zusammen, um einen integrierten Ansatz für Talent Management voranzutreiben. Meldebeziehungen: Diese Position berichtet an den ranghöchsten HRBP-Lead für die BU oder Funktion. Hauptzuständigkeiten und Verantwortlichkeiten: 1. Business/Function Strategic Talent Partnership · Als Teil der Talentstrategie für Unternehmen - als Senior-Most-Talent-Berater für Unternehmens- oder Funktionsleiter fungieren und lokale Geschäftsstrategien, Leistungstreiber und zukünftige Fähigkeiten in umsetzbare Talentpläne für ihre Bereiche übersetzen. Gestalten und beeinflussen Sie Organisationsdesign, Führungszusammensetzung und Personalstrategie, um Wachstum, Innovation und operative Exzellenz für das Unternehmen oder die Funktion zu ermöglichen. 2. Talentmanagement und Nachfolgeplanung · Mithilfe von CoE leiten Sie die Strategie, Durchführung und Governance von Talentmanagementprozessen im gesamten Geschäftsbereich und gewährleisten Tiefe, Vielfalt und Bereitschaft interner Talentpipelines. · Nachfolgeplanung vorantreiben. Die Partnerschaft mit CoE und VP/ED HR ermöglicht strenge Talent Reviews und Entwicklungsplanung sowie interne Mobilität. · Partnerschaft mit dem CoE, um hochkarätige Talente zu beschleunigen und die Führungskompetenz weltweit zu stärken. Nutzen Sie Talent-Dashboards und Analysen, um den Zustand der Pipeline zu verstehen und Aktionspläne zu entwickeln 3. Personalplanung, Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzaufbau · In Zusammenarbeit mit VP/ED und CoE führen wir eine fortlaufende Bewertung und Planung der Fähigkeiten der Mitarbeiter sowie zukünftige Talentanforderungen, Risiken und Lücken durch. Entwickeln und implementieren Sie Capability-Building-Strategien - einschließlich Build / Buy / Borrow / Bot / Bounce-Talent-Ansätze - um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen zukunftsfähig bleibt. 4. Mitarbeitererfahrung und Engagement · In Partnerschaft mit dem Unternehmen CoE setzen Sie sich für lokale Geschäfts- oder Funktionsinitiativen ein, die Engagement, Kultur und Wohlbefinden fördern und eine zusammenhängende und überzeugende Mitarbeitererfahrung in allen Regionen gewährleisten. · Bereitstellung von Insight-gesteuerten Empfehlungen für Hörereignisse, um die Retention, Inklusion und Teameffektivität zu verbessern. 5. Zusammenarbeit und Unternehmensintegration · Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Talentpartnern im Unternehmen und CoE, um Prozesse aufeinander abzustimmen, Erkenntnisse auszutauschen und die Konsistenz bei der Identifizierung, Entwicklung und Unterstützung von Talenten weltweit zu fördern. · Partner funktionsübergreifend im HR-Bereich, um einen integrierten Talentansatz zu gewährleisten, der sowohl Unternehmensziele als auch lokale Geschäftsziele ermöglicht. 6. Data-Driven Talent Insights Nutzen Sie Talentanalysen, um die Strategie zu informieren, den Fortschritt zu messen und organisatorische Risiken oder Chancen für die BU oder Funktion aufzuzeigen. Übersetzen von Personal-, Nachfolge- und Talent-Pipeline-Daten in klare Erkenntnisse, die Geschäfts- und Personalentscheidungen für die BU oder Funktion beeinflussen Führen Sie eine Trendanalyse zu Bewegungs-, Leistungs-, Potenzial-, Retentionsrisiken und Diversität durch, um Chancen oder neue Risiken für die BU oder Funktion zu identifizieren · Nutzen Sie Dashboards für Echtzeit-Sichtbarkeit der Talentgesundheit und der organisatorischen Fähigkeiten für die BU oder Funktion · Bewusstsein für externe Marktbedingungen für Talente – Partnerschaft mit CoE 7. Führungskohorten · Gegebenenfalls Partner mit CoE für die Umsetzung der Führungskräftekohortenentwicklung innerhalb des Geschäftsbereichs, um die Ausrichtung auf die Führungsmodelle von Unternehmen sicherzustellen. Erforderliche Qualifikationen und Erfahrung
• Bedeutende Erfahrung in HR Business Partnering oder Talent
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aperçu de la position Le directeur, Talent Partner, est un chef de file stratégique des RH chargé d'élaborer et de mettre en oeuvre des stratégies axées sur les talents au sein des Opérations, Plasma, Commercial, Fonctions habilitantes et R-D ou Seqirus. Ce rôle, qui est le principal conseiller en matière de talent auprès des cadres supérieurs, veille à ce que les priorités en matière de main-d'oeuvre, de leadership et de culture favorisent directement le rendement, la transformation et la croissance à long terme des entreprises. Chaque partenaire Talent relève directement du vice-président/directeur exécutif, Ressources humaines, pour son secteur d'activité désigné, et collabore étroitement avec les CE Talent et l'ensemble de la communauté des RH afin de favoriser une approche intégrée de la gestion des talents. Rapports : Ce poste relève de la direction la plus haute de la DGRH du BU ou de la fonction. Principales responsabilités et responsabilités : 1. Partenariat stratégique entreprise/fonction Talent · Dans le cadre de la stratégie sur les talents de l'entreprise, agir comme conseiller principal auprès des chefs d'entreprise ou de fonction, en transformant la stratégie d'affaires locale, les facteurs de rendement et les besoins futurs en plans de talents réalisables pour leur secteur. · Façonner et influencer la conception organisationnelle, la composition en leadership et la stratégie de la main-d'oeuvre pour favoriser la croissance, l'innovation et l'excellence opérationnelle de l'entreprise ou de la fonction. 2. Gestion des talents et planification de la relève · Tirer parti du CdE, diriger la stratégie, l'exécution et la gouvernance des processus de gestion des talents dans l'ensemble du secteur d'activité, en assurant la profondeur, la diversité et la disponibilité des pipelines internes de talents. · Conduire la planification de la relève. Établir des partenariats avec le Conseil de l'Europe et la VP/ED RH, faciliter l'examen rigoureux des talents, la planification du développement et la mobilité interne. · S'associer au Conseil de l'Europe pour accélérer les talents de haut niveau et renforcer la capacité de leadership à l'échelle mondiale. · Tirer parti des tableaux de bord et des analyses des talents pour comprendre la santé du pipeline et élaborer des plans d'action 3. Planification des effectifs, renforcement des capacités et des compétences · En partenariat avec le VP/DE et le Conseil de l'Europe, effectuer l'évaluation et la planification continues des compétences de la main-d'oeuvre ainsi que les besoins, les risques et les lacunes futurs en matière de talents. · Élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de renforcement des capacités, y compris des approches axées sur la construction/l'achat/l'emprunt/le placement/l'embauche de talents, afin de s'assurer que l'entreprise reste prête à l'avenir. 4. Expérience et engagement des employés · En partenariat avec le Conseil de l'Europe de l'entreprise, promouvoir les initiatives locales d'affaires ou de fonctions qui élèvent l'engagement, la culture et le bien-être, assurant une expérience des employés cohésive et convaincante dans toutes les géographies. · Fournir des recommandations axées sur la compréhension des événements d'écoute afin d'améliorer la rétention, l'inclusion et l'efficacité de l'équipe. 5. Collaboration et intégration des entreprises · Collaborer étroitement avec d'autres partenaires de talents dans les entreprises et le Conseil de l'Europe pour harmoniser les processus, partager les connaissances et favoriser l'uniformité dans la façon dont les talents sont identifiés, développés et soutenus à l'échelle mondiale. · Établir des partenariats interfonctionnels dans l'ensemble des RH afin d'assurer une approche intégrée des talents qui permette à la fois aux entreprises et aux entreprises locales d'atteindre leurs objectifs. 6. Aperçus sur les talents axés sur les données · Tirer parti de l'analyse des talents pour éclairer la stratégie, mesurer les progrès et mettre en évidence les risques organisationnels ou les possibilités pour l'UB ou la fonction. · Traduire les données sur la main-d'oeuvre, la relève et le bassin de talents en renseignements clairs qui éclairent la prise de décisions en matière d'affaires et de RH pour l'UB ou la fonction · Effectuer une analyse des tendances sur le mouvement, le rendement, le potentiel, les risques de rétention et la diversité afin de cerner les possibilités ou les risques émergents pour l'UB ou la fonction · Tirer parti des tableaux de bord pour une visibilité en temps réel sur la santé des talents et la capacité organisationnelle pour l'UB ou la fonction · Maintenir la sensibilisation aux conditions du marché extérieur pour les talents – partenariat avec le Conseil de l'Europe 7. Cohortes de leadership · Le cas échéant, établir un partenariat avec le Conseil de l'Europe pour la mise en oeuvre du développement de cohortes de leadership dans le secteur d'activité, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les modèles de leadership d'entreprise. Qualifications et expérience requises
• Expérience importante en partenariat d'affaires RH ou talent

jobs.description:
Wer wir sind
CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Biotherapeutika-Unternehmen, das sich der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung lebensrettender Therapien widmet. Mit unseren innovativen Produkten leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Behandlung schwerer und seltener Erkrankungen und verbessern die Lebensqualität von Patientinnen und Patienten weltweit.
Zur Verstärkung unserer HR-Organisation in St. Gallen suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior HR Business Partner Manufacturing (all genders) , die unsere Produktionsbereiche strategisch und operativ unterstützt und aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer leistungs- und werteorientierten Unternehmenskultur beiträgt.

Ihre Rolle
Als Senior HR Business Partner sind Sie eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen HR und dem Business. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, globalen HR-Teams sowie internen und externen Partnern zusammen und tragen maßgeblich zur Umsetzung unserer HR-Strategie im Produktionsumfeld bei.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Umsetzung der globalen und segment-spezifischen HR-Strategie auf regionaler und lokaler Ebene

• Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles (Recruiting, Onboarding, Entwicklung, Performance Management, Retention, Offboarding)

• Coaching von Führungskräften zu Führungsthemen, Mitarbeiterentwicklung und Engagement

• Sicherstellung der konsistenten Anwendung globaler HR-Richtlinien unter Berücksichtigung lokaler rechtlicher und kultureller Anforderungen

• Unterstützung von Organisationsveränderungen (z. B. Reorganisationen, Rollenanpassungen) inkl. Kommunikation und Change-Begleitung

• Förderung einer inklusiven, leistungsstarken und gesundheitsorientierten Unternehmenskultur

• Analyse von HR-Kennzahlen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management

• Unterstützung von Talent- und Nachfolgeplanungsprozessen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen

• Sicherstellung der Compliance mit arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben in Zusammenarbeit mit Employee Relations, Legal und Compliance

• Vorleben und aktive Förderung unserer Unternehmenswerte

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich (Master oder HR-Zertifizierung wie SHRM/CIPD von Vorteil)

• Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante HR-Erfahrung, idealerweise in einem globalen oder matrixorganisierten Umfeld

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in zentralen HR-Disziplinen sowie im Arbeitsrecht

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von HR-Initiativen und Veränderungsprozessen

• Ausgeprägte Organisations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten

• Sicherer Umgang mit HR-Systemen sowie Microsoft Office

• Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

Ihre Kompetenzen

jobs.title: Design & Technology Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la conception et de la technologie

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The Technology & Design Lead is responsible for:

Design ownership and governance across Tier 1 capital projects ($50M+), ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Provide process technology leadership with a focus on aseptic processing. The position ensures robust process definition, system ownership, and ongoing manufacturing support for aseptic equipment operations, fostering consistency and innovation in design and technology execution globally.

Key 
• Responsibilities

Design Element

Establish and maintain appropriate engineering design standards to ensure consistency across all CapEx projects.

Develop and manage a knowledge management program to ensure all design content is available and understood globally and at site levels.

Lead conceptual and detailed design phases for Tier 1 capital projects, ensuring compliance with cGMP, FDA, EMA, and global standards.

Validate design deliverables against project scope, budget, and schedule.

Develop initial project scope, basis of design, and feasibility assessments.

Collaborate with stakeholders to define user requirements and design criteria.

Execute design assurance reviews and health checks at key project milestones.

Identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain design integrity.

Provide expert advice to site engineering teams on design standards and best practices.

Mentor site engineers and promote knowledge sharing across global teams.

Engage with external design partners and EPC firms to ensure quality and compliance.

Negotiate design-related contracts and manage vendor performance.

Implement digital design tools and BIM methodologies for efficiency.

Drive sustainability and modular design strategies in capital projects.

Process Technology

Serve as the global subject matter expert for aseptic processing technologies, ensuring best-in-class practices in project definition and system ownership.

Lead the development and implementation of process technology strategies for aseptic manufacturing, including equipment selection, process flow, and integration with facility design.

Define and own process technology requirements during project scoping, ensuring alignment with regulatory and business needs.

Oversee the specification, design, and qualification of aseptic processing systems and equipment.

Provide technical leadership and support for technology transfer, scale-up, and commissioning of aseptic processes.

Act as system owner for aseptic process technologies, maintaining lifecycle documentation and ensuring ongoing compliance.

Support manufacturing operations by troubleshooting and resolving complex issues related to aseptic equipment and processes.

Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to drive continuous improvement in aseptic operations.

Ensure robust training and knowledge transfer for aseptic process technologies across global sites.

Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes, adapting process technology strategies as needed to maintain competitive advantage and compliance.

Required 
• Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil, or related discipline).

12+ years in engineering design and process technology for GMP-regulated facilities, with at least 8 years in leadership roles.

Proven track record in Tier 1 capital project design, assurance, and aseptic process technology leadership.

PMP or equivalent; LEED or sustainability certification preferred.

Strong knowledge of biopharma facility design, aseptic processing, clean utilities, HVAC, and process systems.

Familiarity with ISPE Baseline Guides, ASTM E2500, and risk-based design approaches.

Experience with biologics, cell & gene therapy, or sterile manufacturing facilities.

Proficiency in BIM, AutoCAD, and digital design platforms.

Global mindset and ability to work in a matrix organization

jobs.title: Principal, Clinical Data Management Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Programmeur Principal (Supervision des Données et Normes)

jobs.description:
The Principal, Clinical Data Management Lead provides leadership and oversight for clinical data build, programming, and vendor deliverables across in-house, hybrid, and outsourced studies, ensuring alignment with CSL standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices .

The role drives governance, review, and validation processes; leads the implementation of CDASH and SDTM standards; and oversees scalable validation frameworks and data quality controls . Additionally, it ensures effective integration of internal and external data into platforms such as the CSL Clinical Data Warehouse, while advancing automation, AI-driven solutions, and strong cross-functional collaboration with Biostatistics, Data Management, Standards, and external partners

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Leads and develops a team of Clinical Data Validators, providing direction on clinical data standards, validation, and oversight activities across in-house, hybrid, and vendor-supported studies.

• Establishes and drives clinical data governance frameworks, including review and validation processes for eCRF builds, SDTM datasets, specifications, and vendor deliverables, ensuring compliance with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

• Oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of clinical data standards (e.g., CDASH, SDTM) and associated validation check libraries to enable consistent, scalable, and high-quality data across studies.

• Provides strategic oversight of data integration processes, including external data flows and system interfaces, ensuring accurate, efficient, and compliant data ingestion into downstream platforms such as the Clinical Data Warehouse.

• Ensures submission readiness of clinical data by establishing robust quality control frameworks and validation processes aligned with regulatory expectations (e.g., SDTM, ADaM, define.xml).

• Develops, maintains, and governs departmental and cross-functional SOPs, standards, and QMS documentation related to clinical data oversight, standards, and programming.

• Drives cross-functional alignment by partnering with Biostatistics, Data Management, Standards, and external partners to ensure consistent understanding and application of clinical data standards and quality expectations; provides guidance, knowledge sharing, and targeted training to support effective implementation across studies.

jobs.description:
Two Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of external innovation opportunities in Hematology, and Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. Embedded within each Therapeutic Area Leadership Team (TALT), these leaders will identify and advance high-potential assets from preclinical through Phase 1 clinical stages, shape early partnering strategies, and drive transactions in collaboration with Business Development ​

We have a hybrid office/home working model. The position will be based in Zurich (preferred) or Maidenhead, UK, with significant business travel

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior Early S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and ensuring external innovation priorities are integrated into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing and scouting efforts for preclinical and Phase 1 assets, building a robust pipeline of opportunities aligned with TA strategy. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Late Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Develop and execute early partnering strategies, including onboarding approaches and competitive positioning for priority assets. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for each opportunity, coordinating scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial assessments to inform governance decisions. ​

• Transaction Execution: Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and cultivating relationships with biotech, academia, and investment communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• Significant tenure in biopharma with significant experience in external innovation, search & evaluation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent). ​

• Must have Deep scientific expertise in Hematology or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of leading due diligence and closing early-stage deals. ​

• Strong network within biotech, academia, and pharma BD organizations. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforc

## Mansioni - Serve as il leader senior di Early S&E all'interno del TALT, influenzando la strategia terapeutica e assicurando che le priorità di innovazione esterna siano integrate nel piano di portafoglio. - Guidare sforzi proattivi di ricerca e scouting per assetti preclinici e di fase 1, costruendo un robusto pipeline di opportunità allineato con la strategia di TA. - Co-guidare riunioni interne (con il Late Search Lead) focalizzate sull'evaluazione e la priorizzazione di Nuove Opportunità di Prodotto (NPO) all'interno di ciascuna area terapeutica di CSL. Le riunioni NPO sono checkpoint strategici dove le squadre cross-funzionali esaminano i potenziali assetti identificati dalla Ricerca e decidono se avanzarli per ulteriori valutazioni e negoziazioni di trattative. - Sviluppare e eseguire strategie di partnering iniziali, comprese le strategie di onboarding e la posizionamento competitivo per gli assetti di priorità. - Guidare la valutazione cross-funzionale per ciascuna opportunità, coordinando le valutazioni scientifiche, cliniche, regolatorie e commerciali per informare le decisioni di governance. - Esecuzione delle trattative: Collaborare strettamente con BD e Regional Ecosystem Leads per avanzare le opportunità di alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la chiusura del trattato, assicurando un passaggio senza intoppi e l'esecuzione. - Rappresentare la TA esternamente, guidando le attività di ricerca in conferenze specializzate e coltivando relazioni con la biotecnologia, l'istruzione accademica e le comunità di investimento. ##
• Requisiti e Esperienze - Tenuta significativa nella biotecnologia con esperienza significativa in innovazione esterna, ricerca e valutazione, o sviluppo aziendale. - Laurea specialistica richiesta (PhD, MD, o equivalente). - Deve avere una profonda conoscenza scientifica nelle aree terapeutiche di Ematologia o Cardiovascolare/Renale. - Provenienza di esperienze di leadership nella valutazione e chiusura di trattative iniziali. - Rete forte all'interno della biotecnologia, dell'istruzione accademica e delle organizzazioni di BD farmaceutico. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Modello di lavoro ibrido ufficio/casa. - Posizione basata a Zurigo (preferito) o Maidenhead, Regno Unito, con viaggi d'affari significativi. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni sui benefici di CSL visita [How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL](https://www.csl.com/). ## Descrizione CSL Behring è un leader globale di biofarmaceutici guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Focalizzati sul servire le esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le ultime tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e consegniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni nelle aree terapeutiche di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia di proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e raffinare continuamente le modalità in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a condurre vite complete. CSL Behring opera una delle reti di raccolta di plasma più grandi del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone e consegna le sue terapie salvavita a persone in più di 100 paesi. Per ulteriori informazioni su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita [https://www.csl.com/](https://www.csl.com/) e CSL Plasma a [https://www.cslplasma.com/](https://www.cslplasma.com/).

jobs.description:
The Opportunity
As Associate Director, Human Factors Design and Development, you will lead the integration of human factors engineering and usability strategies for medical devices, combination products, and healthcare technologies. Your work will ensure that products are safe, effective, and user-friendly—directly impacting patient outcomes and user experience.
In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams across Design, Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and Clinical to embed human factors principles throughout the product lifecycle. You will drive global strategies, support regulatory submissions, and mentor junior staff, helping shape the future of healthcare innovation.

Your Tasks & Responsibilities
Human Factors & Usability Strategy

• Develop and implement global human factors strategies for product design and development.

• Identify critical user interactions, use environments, and potential risks impacting safety and efficacy.

• Integrate human factors early in the design process to minimize risk and optimize usability.
Design & Development Support

• Lead human factors design inputs, design controls, and usability engineering throughout the product lifecycle.

• Guide interface design, labeling, and user instructions to improve user experience.

• Collaborate with R&D, Engineering, and Product Development teams to ensure HF considerations are incorporated into product concepts and prototypes.
Risk Assessment & Validation

• Conduct human factors risk assessments in alignment with ISO 14971 and company risk management procedures.

• Plan and execute formative and summative usability studies.

• Analyze study data to identify usability issues and recommend design modifications.

• Document human factors and usability validation activities for regulatory submissions.
Regulatory & Compliance

• Support preparation of HF-related sections of regulatory submissions (FDA, EU MDR, and other global authorities).

• Ensure HF programs meet all relevant international standards and guidance.

• Serve as a subject matter expert for regulatory inspections related to human factors.
Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to ensure integrated design development.

• Mentor and develop junior HF staff.

• Participate in project planning, milestone reviews, and senior leadership meetings.

Your Skills and Experience

• Master’s or PhD in Human Factors, Industrial Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Ergonomics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field.

• 8–12 years of experience in human factors engineering, usability, or related product development.

• Experience in medical devices, combination products, or healthcare technologies.

• Proven experience conducting formative and summative usability studies.

• Knowledge of human factors standards (IEC 62366, FDA guidance, ISO 14971).

• Expertise in human factors and usability engineering.

• Strong understanding of design controls and risk management.

• Experience with usability study design, execution, and analysis.

• Regulatory knowledge for HF submissions and compliance.

• Cross-functional collaboration and project leadership.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What We Offer

• A senior leadership role shaping the usability and safety of innovative healthcare products.

• The opportunity to drive global human factors strategies and influence product development.

• Collaboration with diverse, cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

• Professional development and advancement opportunities.

• Competitive compensation and benefits, including flexible working arrangements.

• A culture that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies

jobs.description:
We are currently looking for a Principal Scientist Tech Ops (CMC Science) to join our global team in Bern. In this position you will be responsible for supporting and executing Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) strategies for pharmaceutical and/or biologic products across clinical development and early commercialization. This role ensures that drug substance and drug product development activities meet regulatory, quality, and business objectives.​

This role works cross-functionally to drive CMC deliverables, manage external partners, and support global regulatory submissions.

Key Responsibilities

CMC Strategy & Execution

• Contribute to the development and implementation of phase-appropriate CMC strategies​

• Support CMC activities for assigned programs from early development through late-stage clinical development

• Identify risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure timelines and quality standards are met

Process & Analytical Development

• Support drug substance and drug product development activities

• Support analytical method development, validation, and specification setting

• Support process characterization, validation, and lifecycle management

Manufacturing & Tech Transfer

• Manage relationships with CDMOs and manufacturing partners

• Support technology transfer and scale-up activities

• Ensure compliance with GMP requirements

Regulatory Support

• Author, review, and contribute to CMC sections of regulatory submissions (IND, CTA, NDA, BLA)

• Support interactions with global regulatory authorities, including the U.S. Food and Drug Administration and the European Medicines Agency

• Address regulatory questions and inspection readiness activities

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Supply Chain, and Technical Operations teams

• Provide technical expertise to management team

• Support budget planning and timeline management for CMC activities

Your Profile

• PhD, MSc, or equivalent degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or related scientific discipline.

• Typically 8-10 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology development.​

• Demonstrated experience in CMC development and regulatory submissions.​

• Experience managing external manufacturing partners preferred

• Strong scientific and technical expertise in CMC disciplines​

• Knowledge of global regulatory guidelines (ICH, GMP)​

• Project leadership and stakeholder management​

• Risk assessment and problem-solving skills​

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

Are you interested? We are looking forward to receiving your online application

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

jobs.description:
We are looking for a DP Lead parenteral Iron, to join our team in Zurich or St. Gallen, Switzerland. As part of the Integrated Product Team Iron & Small Molecules within Technical Operations, you will be responsible the scoping and execution of technical work packages related to CMC Development, Continuous improvement, and Technology Transfer of parenteral pharmaceutical products and manufacturing processes, as well as providing continuous MS&T support to external partners and CMOs to support routine manufacturing operations. The main focus will be on our iron-based parenteral products.

Key Responsibilities

• Scoping of technical work packages for different types of projects (e.g. CMC Development, Tech Transfer, Continuous Improvement) by defining technical implementation strategies, deliverables and technical risks

• Contribute to and review project execution plans (e.g. technical transfer plans)

• Execute DP related project work packages and tasks as subject matter expert for aseptic and terminally sterilized parenteral products manufacturing as per the project plan

• Proactively engage in periodic cross functional calls and meetings with internal and external team members

• Prepare regular status updates on assigned work packages and tasks as part of regular project reporting and stakeholder management

• Serve as a key technical contact for external partners and CMOs for assigned projects as well as for defined topics in routine manufacturing (including coordination and support in case of technical issues, process changes, major deviations, and improvement initiatives)

• Serve as a key subject matter expert for internal stakeholders (e.g. perform Change Control impact assessments and support quality event investigations)

• Support the evaluation of alternative, cost-effective sourcing strategies for related products as technical SME, including attending technical due diligence visits at potential future CMOs

• Visit of CMOs to oversee technical implementation and troubleshoot as needed

• Provide adequate background information, documentation, and technical advice to decision bodies and negotiation teams to ensure timely decision-making

• Compile and review respective technical documentation

• Proactively engage with CMOs to identify and assess potential to improve quality, compliance and cost efficiency of established processes. Contribute to the establishing of business cases and decision-making processes on implementation of change

Skills & Experience
Minimum Requirements

• Qualification in natural/life sciences or associated engineering degree (i.e. Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Pharmaceutics, etc.), Bachelor/Master level or equivalent

• Minimum 5 years experience in the pharmaceutical industry, direct experience in full scale commercial manufacturing (compounding, aseptic filling, sterilization, CCIT/Visual inspection) of parenteral products for intravenous application

• Self-driven and fast learner with the ability to take ownership execute work packages and tasks independently in a matrix organization

• Confident and proactive team player who collaborates effectively while working autonomously.

• Solid expert knowledge in sterile and aseptic fill & finish CMC development, Equipment -/Process Qualification & Validation, Manufacturing

• High Flexibility and willingness to travel & Experience in External Manufacturing Environment

Preferred Requirements

• Familiarity with GMP requirements and Guidelines related CMC LCM activities, including Annex 1

• Preferably, experience with non-transparent solutions

• Know-how across various parenteral product primary packaging solutions (vials, ampoules, infusion bags)

• Experience in other Drug Product and Finished Product manufacturing & Technology Transfer, e.g. oral solid dosage forms

• Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment

• Strong communication skills

• Analytical thinking & problem-solving skills

• Ability

• Definizione dell'ambito dei pacchetti di lavoro tecnici per diversi tipi di progetti (ad esempio sviluppo CMC, trasferimento tecnologico, miglioramento continuo) definendo strategie di implementazione tecnica, risultati finali e rischi tecnici
• Contribuire e rivedere i piani di esecuzione del progetto (ad esempio piani di trasferimento tecnico)

• Impegnarsi in modo proattivo in chiamate e riunioni interfunzionali periodiche con membri del team interni ed esterni
• Preparare aggiornamenti regolari sullo stato dei pacchetti di lavoro e delle attività assegnati come parte della regolare rendicontazione dei progetti e della gestione delle parti interessate
• Servire come contatto tecnico chiave per partner esterni e CMO per progetti assegnati e per argomenti definiti nella produzione di routine (incluso coordinamento e supporto in caso di problemi tecnici, cambiamenti di processo, deviazioni importanti e iniziative di miglioramento)
• Servire come esperto in materia chiave per le parti interessate interne (ad es. eseguire valutazioni dell'impatto del controllo delle modifiche e supportare indagini sugli eventi di qualità)
• Supportare la valutazione di strategie di approvvigionamento alternative ed economicamente vantaggiose per i prodotti correlati come PMI tecniche, inclusa la partecipazione a visite di due diligence tecnica presso potenziali futuri CMO
• Visita dei CMO per supervisionare l'implementazione tecnica e risolvere i problemi secondo necessità

• Compilare e rivedere la rispettiva documentazione tecnica
• Coinvolgere proattivamente i CMO per identificare e valutare il potenziale di miglioramento della qualità e della conformità e l’efficienza in termini di costi dei processi consolidati. Contribuire alla definizione di casi aziendali e processi decisionali sull'implementazione del cambiamento Competenze ed esperienza Requisiti minimi
• Qualifica in scienze naturali/della vita o laurea in ingegneria associata (ad esempio biologia, biochimica, chimica, farmaceutica, ecc.), livello di laurea/master o equivalente
• Esperienza minima di 5 anni nel settore farmaceutico, esperienza diretta nella produzione commerciale su larga scala (compounding, riempimento asettico, sterilizzazione, CCIT/ispezione visiva) di prodotti parenterali per applicazione endovenosa
• Autodidatta e studente veloce con la capacità di assumersi la responsabilità, eseguire pacchetti di lavoro e attività in modo indipendente in un'organizzazione a matrice.

• Esperienza nella produzione e produzione di altri prodotti farmaceutici e prodotti finiti Trasferimento tecnologico, ad es. forme di dosaggio solide orali
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente multiculturale e internazionale
